mentions.title: King bearings problem
mentions.snippet: Mopar engine forum thread titled as a King bearings problem. The specific fault is not visible in the search snippet and the thread was not opened, so only the title supports this; flagged for a human to read.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 slip onto the main cap and block side groove too easily rather than being an interference fit, raising a risk of spinning the thrust main. The thread states a King technical representative confirmed the 2024 main bearings are out of spec on free spread and said he would not use them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports in-spec measurements on replacement thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling BMW builders to inspect King bearings before installation. The thread reports a set of King N54 rod bearings that contained wrong-size shells mixed into a standard-marked box.
mentions.replyNote: Still returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; thread content could not be read.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: King STDX main bearing sets for BMW S85 blocks reported with thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit, with the poster saying the problem was repeated on two other S85 blocks and on two separate S65 blocks in the same shop.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Poster received a King SI main bearing shell described as malformed in production, crushed and twisted, with no crush in the block journal and unable to slip over the crank journal. Rod bearings from the same order are described as arriving with bearing shaving material and oil inside the shrink wrap.
